title: Mortgage or developer instalments in Dushanbe: compare total cost
excerpt: Compare monthly payments, the down payment, the total and contract risks. The calculation is an illustration, not a bank or developer offer.
contentHtml:
Substantively updated on 15 October 2026.

A mortgage and an instalment plan solve different problems. Compare written terms for a particular apartment: the price under each payment option, deposit, term, payments and when rights are registered. A “0%” promise alone does not establish that there is no extra cost.

What to compare

Write down the full apartment price for immediate payment and for the proposed schedule. Add interest, fees and applicable closing or mandatory service costs. Ask about penalties, early repayment and price changes. If the apartments differ, separate their price difference from the financing cost.

Illustration: monthly payment and total

Assume an apartment price of 800,000 somoni, personal funds of 300,000 and a balance of 500,000. Compare an illustrative amortising loan at 16% annually over 120 months with an illustrative interest-free plan for the same balance over 24 months. Fees and other costs are excluded. These are calculation assumptions, not confirmation of an available instalment plan or loan approval.

ScenarioApprox. monthly paymentApprox. balance repaymentsApprox. total with deposit
Loan, 16%, 120 months8 3761 005 0791 305 079
Illustrative plan, 0%, 24 months20 833500 000800 000

Reading the result

A shorter plan repays principal sooner and requires a larger monthly payment. A longer interest-bearing loan has a lower monthly payment but higher total repayments. Compare the payment with reliable income and reserves rather than your best expected month. Actual schedules may differ because of rounding, fees and interest calculation methods.

Property rights and construction

Do not assume that ownership under every instalment plan starts only after the final payment: the agreement structure and applicable rules matter. Before paying, clarify the contract subject, registration, handover dates, delay remedies and assignment or sale options. Have the particular documents checked with a notary or an appropriate lawyer.

Checking actual terms

We checked Eskhata Bank’s published 16% somoni program on 15 October 2026. An available program does not mean every buyer is approved on those terms. Further examples and direct lender links are in the mortgage article. Obtain the particular developer’s instalment terms in writing.

faq.q: Is an interest-free instalment plan always cheaper?
faq.a: No. Compare the apartment price, schedule and mandatory costs first. A zero interest rate does not exclude a higher property price.

faq.q: Can an apartment be sold before all instalments are paid?
faq.a: There is no single answer without checking the agreement and rights. Clarify registration, sale or assignment requirements with a notary and the contract counterparty.
